arxiv-2510-01184.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yanbo Xu, Sungjae Park, Zhizhou Zhou, Shubham Tulsiani. We present a mechanism to steer the sampling diversity of denoising diffusion and flow matching models, allowing users to sample from a sharper or broader distribution than the training distribution. We build on the observation that these models leverage (learned) score functions of noisy data distributions for sampling and show that rescaling these allows one to effectively control a ‘local’ sampling temperature.

arxiv-2510-05801.title: Generalized capillary‐rise models: existence and fast solvers in integral Hölder spaces
arxiv-2510-05801.creator: Josefa Caballero,Łukasz Płociniczak, Kishin Sadarangani
arxiv-2510-05801.description: Abstract We study a class of nonlinear Volterra integral equations that generalize the classical capillary rise models, allowing for nonsmooth kernels and nonlinearities. To accommodate such generalities, we work in two families of function spaces: spaces with prescribed modulus of continuity and integral Hölder spaces. We establish existence results for solutions within the integral Hölder space framework.

The key challenge is how to preserve the feature expressiveness in each modality while learning cross-modal interactions. pmc-12511155.description: BackgroundSurgical resection followed by adjuvant radiotherapy is a standard approach for brain metastases (BM).
